rent_owner.label: Rent by owner category
rent_owner.desc: Median rent per m² split between allmännyttiga (municipal) and private landlords.
rent_owner.warn: PANEL ONLY, NEVER A MAP. This split exists for six aggregate region groups — Stockholm/Göteborg/Malmö and three size classes — not per kommun. Sweden publishes no private-vs-allmännytta rent split below that.

newbuild_rent.label: New-build rent by rent-setting model
newbuild_rent.desc: Annual rent per m² in newly built rented dwellings, split by how the rent was set: negotiated bruksvärde, presumtionshyra (with or without an investment subsidy) or individually negotiated.
newbuild_rent.warn: PANEL ONLY. Six national groups, three years (2022–2024) — there is no kommun breakdown. Presumtionshyra exempts a new build from the bruksvärde cap for 15 years, which is why new-build rents sit far above the stock they are built next to.

vacancy.label: Vacant dwellings, multi-dwelling buildings
vacancy.desc: Share of dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings standing vacant and available for rent on 1 March, by owner category.
vacancy.warn: STALE AND PANEL ONLY. Triennial, six national groups, and the series stops at 2024 (2019, 2021, 2024) — SCB has announced no next publication, so this does not track the current market. It is a sample survey and carries a margin of error.

cpi_rent.label: CPI, actual rents paid
cpi_rent.desc: Consumer price index, COICOP 04.1 'actual rental payments made for housing', monthly, 2020=100.
cpi_rent.warn: CPI was rebased to 2020=100 in January 2026 — store the base year with the value. Sweden's leases index is CPI for October, not a net price index; the Danish NPI has no counterpart (the Swedish net price index died in 2013M12).

permits.label: Building permits, dwellings
permits.desc: Dwellings granted a building permit for new construction, quarterly.
permits.src: SCB TAB2534 (BO0701 Bygglov) · gross floor area in TAB796
permits.warn: PANEL ONLY, NEVER A MAP AT KOMMUN. Verified 2026-09-20: this table's Region dimension holds 30 codes — riket, the three metro areas, four riksområden and the 21 län. There is no kommun level for building permits. DATA_MAP_SE.md §1b previously implied one; it does not exist.

mortgage_rate.label: Mortgage rate, new agreements
mortgage_rate.desc: Lending rate to households for housing loans, by original rate fixation period, monthly.
mortgage_rate.note: Resolved from the old FM5001C path by scripts/discover_scb.py. TAB5780 carries the wider lending-rate series back to 1987M03. Avtal 0100/0200 distinguish new agreements from outstanding stock — check the label before charting.

gdp.label: GDP, volume change
gdp.desc: GDP at market prices, change in volume against the same quarter a year earlier, and the seasonally adjusted quarter-on-quarter change.
gdp.note: Resolved from the old NR0103B path by scripts/discover_scb.py.

hpi.label: Property price index, småhus
hpi.desc: Fastighetsprisindex (FASTPI) for permanent småhus, Sweden, 1981 = 100, annual.
hpi.warn: Index, not a level — it says how prices moved, never what a house costs. Sweden publishes no open realised price per m² at any geography.

policy_rate.label: Policy rate
policy_rate.warn: NOT YET ON DISK — the Riksbank fetcher is not written. Verified live 2026-09-14: 1.75 % as of 2026-08. STIBOR series closed in 2020 and must not be used.

bond_10y.label: Government bond, 10 yr
bond_10y.warn: NOT YET ON DISK. Verified live 2026-09-14: 3.15 % at 2026-09-09.

cpi.label: CPI
cpi.desc: Consumer price index, total, and KPIF (CPI with fixed interest rate), monthly.
cpi.warn: Rebased to 2020=100 in January 2026 — always store the base year with the value.

note: National series. y/y compares with the same period a year earlier — in percentage points for series that are themselves rates.
